title: A Car Broke the Sound Barrier at 763 MPH, Burning 5 Gallons a Second

scenes.text: A car once broke the sound barrier on land.
On October 15, 1997, ThrustSSC hit 763 miles an hour in Nevada.
It burned about 4.8 gallons of fuel every second.
Two fighter jet engines pushed it, the same type as in a Phantom.
It weighed over ten tons, and Andy Green drove it.
That was exactly 50 years and one day after Chuck Yeager flew past Mach one.

description:
A car once broke the sound barrier on land.
On October 15, 1997, ThrustSSC reached 763 miles an hour in Nevada's Black Rock Desert. Two jet engines pushed it and it burned about 4.8 gallons of fuel every second.
Would you ever sit in that cockpit? Tell us below.
first_comment: It was pushed by two jet engines, not by its wheels. How fast would you dare to go?
